creative_direction: Show Gian as his familiar school-child self, with a sturdy rounded build, short dark hair, and an orange sweater. He lightly touches the back of his head with one hand and smiles in a sheepish friendly way. Keep the front of the face unobstructed and both eyes clear. Use broad warm shapes, excluding shouting, microphones, bullying gestures, or dramatic action. Use graphic color blocks, rounded silhouettes, and two or three broad shadow shapes. Use crimson patterned irises with visible pupils and highlights. Separate abstract black flame-shaped ribbons float behind the shoulders as decoration, touching or burning nothing and implying no attack. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
